name: Gochujang grilled chicken
steps: Mix the gochujang, soy sauce, honey, garlic and sesame oil into a marinade.
Coat the chicken thigh and leave it to sit for a few minutes.
Grill or pan-fry the chicken until charred and cooked through.
Rest briefly, then slice into strips.
Serve over the warm rice with the green onion scattered on top.
